cl.x: Provide SikaBond®-105 ContactFix where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 03.01).

SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is a premium contact adhesive that has been formulated to meet varied needs for lamination and fabrication. SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is fast drying and forms a strong bond that is heat and water resistant.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: SikaBond®-105 ContactFix has a very broad adhesion range and forms a strong and lasting bond. Suitable substrates are timber, rubber sheets, plastic laminates, fabric, cloth backed and polyester backed vinyl, MDF, particleboard, concrete, glass and metal sheets. In the production of transport vehicles SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is suitable for room temperature contact bonding of different covering materials e.g. PUR foams, textiles, adjoining steps, wheel arches, seat brackets and side walls, especially for covering materials with high spring-back forces, cover trims and edging profiles. SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is also suitable for auto upholstery and furniture upholstery. Test with actual substrates and conditions to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions and out of direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage

Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: The adhesion surfaces must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, poorly bonded coatings, loose and friable materials.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.

s: Consumption: 6 - 8m²/ Litre

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: The adhesive is generally applied with a suitable roll-coater, tooth-comb, brush or spray gun. Apply to both surfaces evenly, wait until touch dry, normally 5-8 minutes depending on drying conditions, bring the surfaces together, applying even pressure along the entire bonding surface.

Care must be taken to avoid the formation of adhesive pools on the bonding surfaces. Entrapped solvent causes weak bond.For application on open weave or porous materials, spray apply the adhesive to avoid adhesive bleed through the substrate. Once the container is opened, the material must be consumed in a short time.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Uncured SikaBond®-105 ContactFix may be removed from tools and equipment with Sika® Remover-208, Sika® Colma Cleaner or other suitable solvent. Once cured, hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use Sika® Cleaner-350H.

s: Do not use in temperatures below +10° C, condensed water may form on adhesive and prevent bonding.
For best results apply at ambient, material and adhesive temperatures of +20° C.
Do not apply excessive adhesive, allow adhesive to pool or apply the two substraes together too early. This will cause entrapped solvents which will cause a weak bond or bond failure.
Coverage rate, flash off time, open time and press time are dependant on the type of materials to be bonded and ambient temperature and humidity.
Adhesion tests on specific substrates must be performed prior to use.

cl.x: Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
